supersedes.reason: V1 used an untracked snapshot_download retry policy and admitted a repository from counts and bytes only. V2 binds all file paths and immutable content identities before download.

scientific_evidence_role: prospective acquisition contract only; no model, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim

implementation.network_client: Python urllib.request, one sequential logical request per exact file, no application retry loop

scheduler.start_condition: Wave1 controller is independently TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, all Wave1 services and evaluators have stopped, all four frozen target/evidence roots remain absent, at least 40 GiB is free, and no process references either target.
scheduler.mac_to_server_recovery: Requires a separately frozen recovery using resumable SFTP limited to 4096 Kbit/s; this primary stage never silently changes transport.

acceptance: The scheduler start condition is independently observed before either command starts.
Only the exact 46 sorted files in the immutable-revision v2 manifest are requested.
Every response is HTTPS status 200 and redirect metadata is retained without signed URLs.
All eight LFS payloads match their frozen SHA-256 and all 38 non-LFS files match their frozen Git blob SHA-1.
Every observed file receives a retained SHA-256; counts and byte totals match each model and the complete manifest.
Both evidence roots report one logical request per file, zero retries, TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, and no TERMINAL_REJECTED.
failure: Any premature start, collision, unsafe path, timeout, HTTP error, identity mismatch, byte mismatch, file-set mismatch, storage breach, or evidence mismatch seals the fresh evidence root as TERMINAL_REJECTED and retains the partial target. A recovery requires new roots and a separately frozen contract.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit and archive both model identities, then freeze a lifecycle successor that binds their exact records. Model acceptance does not authorize lifecycle or numerical execution.
prohibited_actions: executing the superseded v1 model contracts
starting while Wave1 or any Wave1 service remains active
using snapshot_download, a moving revision, an implicit cache, or an application retry
loading a model or installing dependencies during acquisition
repairing, resuming, overwriting, or deleting a rejected target in place
populating a comparison-table numeric cell from model acquisition
